basic_profile.bio: Avid tinkerer and 3D printing enthusiast based in Austin, Texas. With a background in engineering, I spend my free time exploring new tech trends and gadgets. I enjoy experimenting in the kitchen, especially after a drink or two, and I'm a big fan of online gaming, particularly Valorant. During the weekdays, I work as a mechanical engineer, which often spills over into my hobbies. Currently single, I usually browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in mechanical engineering and a passion for hands-on projects, I've self-taught myself much of what I know about 3D printing. I often turn to online communities to exchange tips and tricks. My gaming expertise comes from years of playing and watching esports.
